body: BLOCK exact 459640df44869536d46b8c4faa141096c8302428 on one narrow source contradiction. Section 5 says Unranked means no ranking evidence existed and never means participant content. That meaning is correct for this calibration estimand, but CandidateSet.without at candidates.scala:38-40 can turn a previously nonempty candidate set into CandidateSet(empty, abstained=true). GraphHsmm then routes that ablation-empty unit to Unranked. The current court uses independent control runs, so the defect is a missing execution precondition rather than a changed estimand. Required successor: state that every channel comparison is a fresh complete generation/inference run and that CandidateSet.without or any ablation-empty path is nonconforming until it has a typed state distinct from provider abstention; add a mutation/refusal row for an ablation that removes the last nomination. All prior scientific repairs and the whitespace delta remain accepted. This formal block corrects my earlier content approval in light of the newly inspected public path.
